description: Coastal trading voyage reports is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts (DITRDCSA); Shipping Business Unit. Members: Maritime Business - Voyage Reports; Voyage Reports. Example entry: The Coastal Trading (Revitalising Australian Shipping) Act 2012 requires copies of all voyage reports received to be published on the Department's website. Coverage is Australia, 2012 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as weekly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-12-18. Files and pages listed: HTML, XLSX (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU; other members not stated. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
